claude.lens: Proof-adversarial. Try to falsify the operational recovery-to-compression theorem, all fidelity conventions/constants, rare-event lemma, exact environment pullbacks, p=0 extension, moving invariant code and channel-boundary comparison, and finite code/decoder with its asymptotic exponent. Identify precisely any missing mathematical hypothesis. A valid special-case derivation alone is not enough for the quantified claim.

grok.lens: Quantitative/resource. Independently recompute the eta/gamma scale, compression caps, trajectory constant22 and discrimination constant1/264; test gamma->0, eta->0, spectators, moving codes, channel boundaries, and optimal-vs-achieved recovery. Audit all costs and determine whether the explicit scaling witness supports ONLY compression sharpness. Find any hidden computation or uncharged simultaneous-noise premise.

agy.lens: Non-claims/attribution. Audit title, abstract, full theorem scope, README, CLAIMS, SOURCES and metadata against the proofs. Distinguish imported approximate-QEC duality and linear-metrology principle from the new finite-damping/nonlinear application. Is the candidate a coherent scoped technical contribution, or only a restatement? Do not pretend to search literature or certify novelty. Check the strict common invariant-code premise, hypothetical primitive, non-attainment of dynamical sharpness, no physical implementation or unrestricted no-go, and review/formal/publication status.
